body.p: Earlier there was a very rich person, he had a worker. The person went to the mountains in early spring; his worker followed him as soon as he had left. The rich person didn't feed the worker, he said to his worker: "Why can't you go more quickly?" [DCh]: Why reflexive possessive suffix at "eËdawá»"?The rich person hit his worker. His worker lost much weight, soon he would die. The worker got very angry, by night he thought out to kill the rich person. Once at night the worker took an axe, when it had become night, he chopped his head until it fell off. The [rich person's] wife ran out naked, when that one killed her husband. The worker married that one's wife.
